content:
Maya: Heads up — flying into BUE next week, staying around Palermo/San Telmo. Looking for great empanadas (and a late-night coffee spot). Any must-visits? Also — GF options?

Carlos: El Sanjuanino is classic for empanadas (try the carne picante). Heads up it's more Recoleta but worth the trip. 

Priya: For San Telmo try 'La Cocina de los Abuelos' — tiny spot, amazing humita empanadas. Not GF though.

Sam: If Maya needs GF, check 'Senza Trigo' (GLUTEN-FREE bakery). They do empanada-like pastries on weekends. Open Sat 10-16.

Ben: Late coffee = 'Hasta La Muerte Coffee' (Palermo). Open until ~1am on Fri/Sat. Great flat whites and work-friendly vibe.

Mateo: Also "Mercado de San Telmo" food stalls are solid during the day — lots of empanada stands, cheap and quick. 

Maya: Awesome recs, thanks! Anyone have addresses or a short list I can copy into my notes?

Carlos: Quick list —
```
El Sanjuanino — Posadas 1515, Recoleta
La Cocina de los Abuelos — Defensa 800, San Telmo
Senza Trigo — Nicaragua 6000, Palermo (GF bakery)
Hasta La Muerte Coffee — Honduras 5900, Palermo Soho
Mercado de San Telmo — Defensa 963
```

Priya: +1 for Mercado stalls if you want cheap sampling. And if you want something sit-down and fancy, La Cabrera (parrilla) is nearby but not empanadas.

Sam: If anyone else is in BUE that week, should we do a mini empanada crawl? 🍽️

Ben: I'm visiting the week after, would def join. :raised_hands:

Mateo: Count me in for the crawl — can do Sat afternoon.

lunchbot: Poll created — "Empanada crawl Sat?" Options: Yes / No / Maybe. Vote with :one:/:two:/:three:.

Maya: Perfect — added to calendar if poll says yes. Thanks y'all, very helpful!
